message.content:
One pound (lb) equals approximately **0.453 592 37 kilograms**.  
So:

\[
\text{weight}_{\mathrm{kg}} \;=\;\text{weight}_{\mathrm{lb}}\times 0.453\,592\,37 .
\]

If you’re looking at just “how many kilograms are in a pound,” it’s roughly **0.45 kg** when rounded to two decimal places.
